items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: So when Joe brought that tune in, Zawinul, to, I think we were rehearsing in Teaneck, New Jersey. We rehearsed in Nat Adderley’s basement out there.

ctx.x: They sure did. There was some very great piano players too, with the band of course. When tunes like “Mercy, Mercy” and stuff, when — you would read them in rehearsal, did you get a sense of — this tune is going to sell a lot of records?

Yeah. You know, we were always, well we were hoping, we were always experimenting. That band was experimenting all the time. And we played straight ahead jazz, we played all kinds of stuff. So when Joe brought that tune in, Zawinul, to, I think we were rehearsing in Teaneck, New Jersey. We rehearsed in Nat Adderley’s basement out there.
Is that from the song Teaneck he wrote?
